messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: [P1] Equinox (VPC, dedicated pool) reporting >95% tool/function-call failures since 07:12 UTC. Error: parser/validation failures. Paging on-call.
alejandro: on it, grabbing logs from the dedicated pool. any customer impact visible on console?
ops-bot: Alert summary: 07:11:58 -> surge in 400-level responses from toolcall-parser, rate 120/s. 30% of requests hit schema validation error 'unexpected_field_type'.
Mei Chen: saw a spike in parser exceptions in the pool: stack traces point to parser v2.3.1 line 242 (jsonpath logic). could be regression from yesterday's runtime update.
Samir Patel: Equinox on Dedicated, pool id dp-345, tenant isolation fine. Impact: their live inference returning toolcall failures causing app errors for a subset of users (payments flow). They reported timeouts downstream.
Katie R: tagging @equinox-sre to confirm on-customer symptoms. equinox-sre: are you seeing app errors or degraded UX?
equinox-sre: Their UI shows a 'retry' modal for 40% of requests, errors started ~07:10 and persisted. They put their traffic on a retry loop which amplified load.
Jess L: quick risk assessment: this looks like schema drift + parser regression. two mitigation vectors: 1) rollback parser to v2.2.8 on the dedicated pool, 2) apply a permissive shim that accepts unexpected_field_type and coerces values for compatibility. rollback is fastest but has deploy risk.
alejandro: I can push a targeted rollback to dp-345. need approval from infra lead @Mei Chen. Mei?
Mei Chen: go for rollback to v2.2.8 on dp-345. make it canary first 10% then 100% if green. watch KV cache hits and latency.
Samir Patel: I'll open a CR to route Equinox traffic to fallback model variant (hosted-compatible) if rollback fails. That'd avoid app-level outages.
Katie R: coordinate incident comms: CS alerted customer; status page draft in #customer-status ready once we have mitigation. keep messages explicit: "We see parser validation errors, mitigation in progress, minimal data loss, ETA 30m."
alejandro: executing rollback canary now. command: ```
# rollback parser runtime on dedicated pool dp-345
infractl service update --pool dp-345 --component parser --image redwood/parser:v2.2.8 --canary 10%
```
ops-bot: Deploy started: canary rollout to 10% at 07:18:34 UTC. CI checks passed.
Mei Chen: monitoring logs/metrics, looking at parser exception rate and error budget.
Jess L: meanwhile create a permissive shim config to accept both string/array for field 'tool_args' and coerce arrays to comma string. snippet: ```json
{"compat": {"tool_args": {"accept": ["string","array"], "coerce": "array->csv"}}}
```
alejandro: I can stage the shim as a hotfix on dp-345 if canary shows no regressions. prepping deployment.
equinox-sre: customer can do a short maintenance window if needed but prefer no-change. they are tracking user errors.
IncidentBot: Update: canary at 10% reported 5% failure rate -> down from 95%, latencies stable. Rolling to 100% in 60s.
alejandro: rolling to 100% now. command: ```
infractl service update --pool dp-345 --component parser --image redwood/parser:v2.2.8 --canary 100%
```
ops-bot: Rollout completed at 07:22:12 UTC. Error-rate on parser back to baseline (~1.2%).
Samir Patel: Awesome. I'm going to keep fallback routing on standby but not enable. leaving feature flag open: `route.equinox.fallback=false`.
Katie R: CS updated customer with initial message and said we'll follow up with RCA. customer response: "Thanks, saw errors drop, will monitor."
Mei Chen: let's capture traces and sample failed payloads for RCA. we need to know which example triggered the parser path. please run: ```
# fetch sample failures from dp-345
infractl logs --pool dp-345 --component parser --filter "validation_error" --limit 200 > eqx_samples.log
```
alejandro: grabbing samples now. found repeated pattern: field `tool_call.params` occasionally arrives as nested object instead of flattened map. sample payload: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "charge_user", "params": {"amount": "100", "currency": "USD"}, "tool_args": ["urgent","verified"]}}
``` which v2.3.1 expected `tool_call.params` to be map<string,string> but runtime change tightened validation causing 'unexpected_object' error.
Jess L: that's schema drift from customer's payload. It used to be accepted; parser v2.3.1 tightened types. we should treat this as backward-incompatible change that sneaked in.
Samir Patel: For hotfix we applied rollback; for medium-term we'll add a compatibility layer that tolerates nested param objects and coerces types. also add a regression test to our eval harness with Equinox sample payloads.
Katie R: Incident severity review: P1 initially, customer impact reduced, recommend post-incident to be P2 for follow-up RCA and regression patch. agree?
Mei Chen: agree. create follow-up ticket assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml. include test vectors.
alejandro: creating ticket. ticket id: INC-2026-9843, title: "Equinox: parser v2.3.1 validation regression - compat shim + tests". assigning to @Samir and @Jess.
Samir Patel: ack, I'll own the compatibility shim and tests. ETA 3 days. plan: add tolerance layer + run canary against dedicated pools.
ops-bot: Note: we did a customer-specific rollback. please update runbook steps for dedicated pool hotfixes to include canary commands and CS comms template.
Katie R: will handle runbook update. Also schedule a 30m postmortem sync with Equinox SRE tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
alejandro: final note — preserve all logs/trace IDs for 72h. I've exported samples and traces to s3://redwood-incident-archive/equinox/1907654321/
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Errors returned to baseline, customer confirms recovery. Closing page at 07:34:49 UTC. Follow-ups: INC-2026-9843 (compat shim), runbook update, postmortem meeting. :white_check_mark:
Jess L: thanks team. blameless postmortem, include timeline, code diff that introduced the strict validation (CR 5234) and regression tests to prevent recurrence.
Mei Chen: handing off to day on-call for follow-up: @Katie R will own. Katie?
Katie R: taking handoff. I'll run the postmortem and update status page after meeting. closing thread for on-call handoff. :wave:
